liveResearch.title: RESEARCH WORKSPACE
liveResearch.headline: Explore the latest recorded observations.
liveResearch.body: Open Narrative Radar to inspect collected social activity, source snapshots and narrative scores. Sign in to load the research available to your account.
liveResearch.note: Observations are collected on a schedule. Coverage is sampled; scores are research estimates, not predictions.

landing.eyebrow: A clearer view of what’s forming
landing.messageOnly: Email or Google sign-in. No wallet connection.
landing.howTitle: Follow the signal. Understand the story.
landing.howBody: Connect the conversation, the narratives and the tokens. Make up your own mind with more context.
landing.step1Body: See narratives by stage and momentum. Understand what is emerging and what is already crowded.
landing.step2Body: Explore related tokens and market observations, with the uncertainty kept in view.
landing.step3Body: Research is context, not a promise. Check the evidence and decide what deserves a closer look.
landing.previewBody: Explore an interactive sample of the research workspace. All figures below are illustrative, not live signals or performance claims.
landing.sampleNote: Sample score history. Not price, returns or a forecast.
landing.accessBody: Research features follow your access level. Access is granted locally; no token holding is required.
landing.trust1Body: Privy verifies your session. Narrax never asks for a seed phrase and cannot move funds.
landing.trust2Body: Privy handles sign-in with email or Google. Narrax does not request a wallet connection.
landing.trust3Body: Narrax stores your access level and security audit records. We never ask for a seed phrase.
landing.faq1Title: Does signing in let Narrax use my funds?
landing.faq1Body: No. Narrax is a research workspace. It never requests a transaction, delegation or transfer.
landing.faq2Body: No. Sign in with email or Google. Access is granted locally and does not require a token holding.
landing.faq3Body: Check that early access is open and that an admin grant is active. Access checks run on every request.
landing.faq4Body: No. Narrax is a research tool. Scores, rankings and observations are evidence with limitations, not guarantees or predictions of returns.
landing.finalTitle: The next story starts before the headlines.
landing.finalBody: Build your own view of the narratives taking shape on NEAR.
